name: cf_dns_open_autamedica_records
description: Abre la zona DNS de autamedica.com en Cloudflare con la sesion CDP actual

steps.description: Cerrar el centro de preferencias/cookies si aparece

args.script: (async () => { const labels = ['allow all', 'close preference center', 'aceptar', 'allow']; const findButton = () => [...document.querySelectorAll('button,[role="button"],a')].find((el) => { const text = (el.innerText || el.textContent || '').trim().toLowerCase(); return labels.some((label) => text.includes(label)); }); const button = findButton(); if (button) { button.click(); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 750)); return 'cookie preferences dismissed'; } return 'cookie preferences not present'; })()

steps.description: Validar que se llego a DNS y no a login

args.script: (async () => { const start = Date.now(); while (Date.now() - start < 15000) { const text = (document.body.innerText || '').toLowerCase(); const hasLogin = text.includes('iniciar sesión en cloudflare') || !!document.querySelector('input[type="email"], input[name="email"]'); if (hasLogin) { throw new Error('Cloudflare login required in persistent profile'); } const hasDnsSignals = text.includes('dns') || text.includes('records') || text.includes('agregar registro') || text.includes('add record'); if (hasDnsSignals) { return 'dns page visible'; } await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 500)); } throw new Error('DNS page did not become visible'); })()
